dir.description: Absolute path to a Rust project/workspace, or to a parent containing one unambiguous nested Cargo project.

target.description: Every target is read-only. check: cargo check; clippy: Clippy with -D warnings; test: cargo test; doc: documentation tests; fmt: cargo fmt --check only and NEVER rewrites files; all: formatting check, workspace Clippy, all-target tests, then applicable documentation tests. If fmt fails, run cargo fmt --all in the terminal before another check.

timings.description: Optional diagnostic mode. Adds stable Cargo --timings to build-capable steps, reads only the bounded report under the selected target directory, and reports critical units/linker time when Cargo exposes them. It never changes Cargo config and does not grant extra authority.

detail.description: Output detail. compact (default): at most 5 root diagnostics, patch summary, no raw tail; standard: bounded rendered details; full: bounded raw tail for explicit debugging.

dir.description: Absolute path to the Rust project directory (or the file's directory when path is given).

path.description: Optional single file (relative to dir) to audit instead of the whole tree.

dir.description: Absolute Rust workspace or package directory containing Cargo.lock.

symbol.description: Optional Rust item name, for example Widget or widget.

version.description: Optional exact version from Cargo.lock. Required when the lock file has multiple matching versions.

source.description: Optional Cargo.lock source selector (registry, git, path, or exact source URL) when name and version are still ambiguous.

expensiveFallback.description: Explicitly allow bounded cargo doc generation after cache, source, and docs.rs routes fail. Default false.

name.description: Crate name to verify (e.g. serde_json). Also detects standard-library modules that should not become crates.

version.description: Optional exact version to check against crates.io (e.g. 1.0.140).

dir.description: Absolute path to the Rust project directory (workspace root or member).

path.description: Path to the .rs file, relative to dir (or absolute within the workspace).

line.description: 1-based line containing the symbol; used with symbol to resolve the exact position.

dir.description: Absolute path to the Rust project directory.

path.description: Path to the .rs file within the workspace.

includeContents.description: Include full contents for at most three workspace files.
